meta.name: fastapi-expert
meta.description: Use when building high-performance async Python APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic V2. Invoke to create REST endpoints, define Pydantic models, implement authentication flows, set up async SQLAlchemy database operations, add JWT authentication, build WebSocket endpoints, or generate OpenAPI documentation. Trigger terms: FastAPI, Pydantic, async Python, Python API, REST API Python, SQLAlchemy async, JWT authentication, OpenAPI, Swagger Python.

copy.tagline: 用 FastAPI 快速构建高性能异步 Python API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Python 开发高性能异步 API 服务
copy.tagline_en: Build high-performance async Python APIs with FastAPI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building high-performance async API services with Python

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用 FastAPI 和 Pydantic V2 编写高性能的异步 Python API。它会生成 REST 端点、数据模型、认证流程、数据库操作、WebSocket 端点以及 OpenAPI 文档。
howto.when: 当你提到 FastAPI、Pydantic、async Python、REST API Python、SQLAlchemy async、JWT authentication、OpenAPI 等关键词，或要求构建 Python API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 FastAPI 创建一个用户注册的 REST 端点。
给这个 FastAPI 项目添加 JWT 认证。
用 async SQLAlchemy 实现数据库操作。
say.note: Claude 会生成异步 CRUD 函数和模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you build high-performance async Python APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic V2. It generates REST endpoints, Pydantic models, authentication flows, async SQLAlchemy database operations, WebSocket endpoints, and OpenAPI documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like FastAPI, Pydantic, async Python, REST API Python, SQLAlchemy async, JWT authentication, OpenAPI, or request building a Python API.

say_en.text: Create a user registration REST endpoint with FastAPI.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Pydantic models, router, and CRUD code.

say_en.text: Add JWT authentication to this FastAPI project.
say_en.note: Claude will provide security.py and dependency injection code.

say_en.text: Implement database operations using async SQLAlchemy.
say_en.note: Claude will generate async CRUD functions and models.
